question: When did the British army under Eyre Coote defeat Haider Ali at Porto Novo and save Madras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**July 1781.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The English captured the** French port Mahe **which was of great importance to Hyder Ali.
 
• So, he protested and declared war against the British.
 
• **In 1781** the British army under Sir Eyre Coote defeated Hyder Ali at Port Novo.
 
• **In 1782** **Hyder Ali died** of cancer. So, Tipu Sultan continued the war.
 
• **In 1784**, he signed the Treaty of Mangalore with the English by which the conquered territories were restored to both parties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Second Anglo-Mysore War started in 1780** when Hyder Ali of Mysore declared war against the British.
 
• This was in response to an English attack on Mahe, which was a French possession and in Hyder Ali’s dominion.
 
• In July of that year, Hyder Ali invaded the Carnatic.
 
• In this battle, the British suffered a heavy defeat.
 
• After this, Ali renewed the **siege of Arcot.**
 
• This prompted the British to gear up their defenses in South India.
 
• It also sends reinforcements under **Sir Eyre Coote,** a British army **officer to Madras.**
